Document.title: Grand Prix circuit
Document.p: Build under Civic at 40% technology. Cost $140,000, footprint 6 by 6. Connect any side to track, road or rail. Each operating day needs 35 labor, 20 water, 100 low-voltage electricity and 12 goods, and produces 3 waste. Upkeep is $20 per day even when idle. A supplied event day earns $45 in service receipts, listed under Service revenue. The circuit creates labor demand and adds some pollution.
Select the building to check inventory and input shortages. Use warehouses and markets for supplies, and keep waste moving to disposal.
